label: WRONG
reason: Handlers take the DbSession dependency (Depends(_get_db_dependency), database.py:98) because they query the database (api_keys.py, users.py, health_scores.py); every outlier simply needs no session: static responses (meta.py get_coverage, main.py root, outgoing_webhooks.py list_event_types, oura_webhooks.py health), challenge/probe handlers (webhooks.py, oura_webhooks.py), the SNS forwarder, and the SSE stream in sync_status.py, which deliberately avoids DbSession to not hold a pooled connection open. New DB-less handlers would be flagged for nothing; 'wrapped in' also misstates that it is an injected parameter dependency.
